title: Microsoft 365 admin center: agent-level controls for pay-as-you-go
summary: The briefing distinguishes the planned agent-level billing controls from the existing service-level billing policies, and its roadmap details, licensing and administrative paths are supported. Two automation entries need clearer presentation: the spending-policy endpoint includes explanatory text, and the Azure budget entry describes an automation method rather than providing a runnable call.
